description: Small inline status or count badge. Colour reinforces the text, never replaces it. Surface elements use bare data-* attributes.

attributes.name: data-size
attributes.description: Size: s (11px floor) or l; omit for the default (--font-size-xs).

attributes.name: data-color
attributes.description: Semantic (primary, success, warning, error, info) or theme (brand, secondary, accent) colour. Colour is never the only signal: the badge text must carry the meaning.

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: subtle (mode-aware tint with --color-*-text ink) or outlined (transparent, border in the text colour) instead of filled.

attributes.name: data-shape
attributes.description: square: square corners instead of a pill. ribbon (V cut at the inline end), notch (V cut at the inline start), flag (point at the inline end), double-arrow (points at both ends) and stamp (concave corners) are decorative shapes painted behind the text; they mirror in RTL, never clip the label or the focus outline, and fall back to a bordered rectangle in forced colours. Tune the notch depth with --badge-notch.

cssProperties.name: --badge-notch
cssProperties.description: Notch / point depth of the decorative data-shape values (default 0.75em); the padding on the notched side grows by the same length.

cssProperties.name: --badge-shape-fill
cssProperties.description: Fill of a decorative shape (default: the badge background for its data-color / data-variant). Accepts gradients.
